features.availability: Every constituent close is from an exact completed 8-hour bar at or before decision_time.
features.formula: log(close_t / close_(t-1)) minus the same-bar cross-sectional median log return
features.lag: zero additional lag after each source bar closes
features.missing_rule: Omit a symbol with any missing exact close; flatten if fewer than 24 valid symbols remain.

features.availability: Both windows end strictly before the three shock bars.
features.formula: sample_std(21 residual returns immediately before shock) / sample_std(prior 84 residual returns)
features.lag: latest three residual returns excluded from both volatility windows
features.missing_rule: Zero signal strength at or above ratio 1.00; full strength at or below 0.45; omit an invalid baseline scale.

features.availability: All three shock returns are closed by decision_time; their scale ends before the shock.
features.formula: sum(last 3 residual returns) / (prior 84-bar residual volatility * sqrt(3))
features.lag: prior scale plus latest three completed bars
features.missing_rule: Zero recoil signal for a zero cumulative shock.

features.availability: Uses only the same three completed shock returns.
features.formula: require at least 2/3 bars to share cumulative sign; bound magnitude by median aligned component; divide by sum(abs(shock))/abs(sum(shock))
features.missing_rule: Set recoil signal to zero when sign agreement, aligned median, or roughness validity fails.

features.availability: All upstream compression and shock inputs satisfy their causal rules.
features.formula: negative shock direction * compression strength * tanh(durable shock z / 2.5) * agreement^2 / path roughness
features.missing_rule: Inactive but otherwise valid symbols remain exactly zero.

features.availability: Built only after raw recoil scores are frozen.
features.formula: deterministic within-sign magnitude ranks; inactive names remain zero
features.missing_rule: Capture one empty built-in dictionary on a scheduled construction failure.

raw_fields.coverage: Only Amendment 0006 certified point-in-time pure-crypto eligible symbols.
raw_fields.lag: bar must be fully closed at decision_time
raw_fields.missing_rule: Require exactly one finite positive close at each of 127 exact opens; never forward fill.

raw_fields.coverage: Pure-crypto point-in-time membership intersected with organizer executability.
raw_fields.missing_rule: Reject duplicates; require at least 24 valid symbols.
